frozen_reference.note: The frozen base teacher is the staged omniASR-CTC-1B-v2.pt checkpoint (CTC_MODEL_ARTIFACTS, sha256 354f9817). It has NO fine-tuned export/model.pt, so its scoring runs in the evaluator's base-mode: the evaluator stages the base checkpoint, sha-verifies it against CTC_MODEL_ARTIFACTS, and decodes with it directly (BASE_MODE_NO_EXPORT_LOAD). This scoring reference pins the base decode identity for the nomination scorer, parallel to ARM2-ARM1-SCORING-REFERENCE-2026-001; there is no tar artifact because base loads no export.
